top_news.title: Chain-of-Models: Cross-Model Auditing for Bias-Robust LLM Judges
top_news.dek: Chain-of-Models (CoM) uses a secondary LLM to audit the reasoning traces of a primary model to reduce cognitive bias in automated judgments.
top_news.brief: Researchers evaluated CoM across nine models and four bias types, finding that auditor identity significantly impacts performance. The study suggests that using a different-family model as an auditor can effectively mitigate biases that prompt-based debiasing fails to address, offering a scalable alternative to human evaluation.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing a primary LLM generating a reasoning trace audited by a secondary LLM.

top_news.title: Show HN: Nightcrawler – A local AI pentesting agent running on a smartphone
top_news.dek: Nightcrawler is an open-source autonomous penetration testing agent designed to run locally on smartphones.
top_news.brief: The tool operates without cloud connectivity, enabling users to drop a device on a network to discover hosts, map services, and identify vulnerabilities. It automates the red-teaming process and generates security reports directly from the mobile hardware.
top_news.image_alt: Nightcrawler mobile pentesting interface on a smartphone

top_news.title: Microsoft Agent Framework Harness and Hosted Agents Reach General Availability
top_news.dek: Microsoft has reached general availability for its Agent Framework Harness and Foundry Hosted Agents.
top_news.brief: The release transitions the framework from a development SDK to a governed platform for production agent deployment. It includes stable support for GitHub Copilot and Claude Agent SDK connectors, alongside standardized orchestration patterns.

top_news.title: Introducing our Artifacts Hub and Adoption Dashboard
top_news.dek: Interconnects has launched the Artifacts Hub and Adoption Dashboard to track open model ecosystem trends.
top_news.brief: The new tools aggregate data from Hugging Face, Open Router, and Artificial Analysis to provide curated insights into model intelligence and relative adoption metrics. These resources aim to offer deeper visibility into the state of open-source AI.
top_news.image_alt: Screenshot of the Artifacts Hub dashboard interface

primary.title: Chain-of-Models: Cross-Model Auditing for Bias-Robust LLM Judges
primary.summary: LLMs increasingly serve as automated judges, but their judgments remain vulnerable to cognitive biases. Existing mitigations mostly rely on prompt-driven debiasing, which is brittle across bias types, or human evaluation, which does not scale. We study Chain-of-Models (CoM), an automated audit pipeline in which a second model inspects the first model's reasoning trace before producing the final judgment.
